subject: Acme Analytics renewal — PO and billing contact for upcoming invoice
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Cc: accounts.payable@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-02-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal: PO & billing contact for upcoming invoice

Hi Lisa / Acme procurement team,

Hope you’re doing well — excited to get the renewal and expansion for Acme finalized. Per our renewal conversation, the order will include:
- Annual renewal for Hosted API (2x seats)
- Expansion: add 2 Dedicated GPU nodes (burst capacity) starting on renewal date

To complete the billing flow on our side we need:
1) A PO referencing deal RDF-2026-ACME-02 (PO number, billing address, and bill-to contact)
2) Confirmation of net terms (you mentioned net30 in the call)
3) Any required tax forms (W-9 or equivalent) and a billing email for invoice delivery (AP contact)

If you can attach the PO and the AP contact I’ll route to our billing team and get an invoice out within 5 business days. If you prefer we can issue the invoice first and you provide the PO for matching — let me know which works best for Acme.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on finalizing the invoice until I get the PO / AP contact.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: quote_redwood_acme_2026-02.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, accounts.payable@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-02-24T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: PO & billing contact for upcoming invoice

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — attaching the signed PO (PO_54321.pdf). Acme Finance confirms: net30 on receipt of invoice. Please send the invoice to accounts.payable@acme-analytics.com and reference PO #54321 and RDF-2026-ACME-02 in the invoice header. Billing address below:

Acme Analytics Inc.
Attn: Accounts Payable
123 Commerce Way
San Francisco, CA 94105
EIN: 94-1234567

We have also attached a placeholder W-9 for your records (W9_pending.pdf) — we are happy to provide a formal W-9 once I confirm with our tax team; could you also confirm whether Redwood needs any additional tax documentation for the Dedicated nodes?

Let me know when the invoice has been issued and we’ll route payment per net30.

Best,
Lisa Cheng
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Acme Analytics
lisa.cheng@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: PO_54321.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); W9_pending.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-24T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Acme PO_54321 — need billing confirmation and tax docs

Vivek / Aditya,

Forwarding Acme’s PO and note that they’ve requested net30. PO #54321 attached. Can our billing group issue a single invoice that covers the annual renewal + expansion line items and mark net30? Also: request from client for W-9 confirmation — they sent a placeholder and will provide the formal W-9 soon.

Quick questions:
- Any reason we can’t accept net30 for this account for this renewal?
- Should we lock the invoice to the PO number or issue first and then match to PO?
- Tax: I believe W-9 is sufficient for US customers, but confirm if we need any other forms for Dedicated hardware billing.

I’ve drafted an invoice (attached) — feel free to edit and finalize. If you can sign off today I’ll send to Acme and include the Doc link for payment instructions.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: invoice_draft_ACME_2026-02.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Marissa / Aditya,

Net30 is fine for this customer and for the renewal + Dedicated node expansion — approved. Please ensure the invoice includes:
- PO #54321 (visible on first page)
- RDF-2026-ACME-02 as our deal reference
- Line-level costs for Hosted API renewal and Dedicated node add-on (unit counts and monthly equivalent)

Tax/tables: a standard W-9 will be sufficient for Acme as a US entity; no additional forms required on our side. If they provide a W-9 we’ll upload to the customer record.

Action items for Marissa: finalize invoice PDF, send to accounts.payable@acme-analytics.com with payment instructions and our bank wiring details. Copy me on the send so I can confirm the receivable.

If they ask for a revised term (e.g., net45 or special credit) escalate to me — otherwise proceed.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Hi Lisa / AP team,

Thanks again for the PO — we’ve issued the invoice and attached it here. Summary:
- Invoice: invoice_v1_ACME_20260302.pdf (attached)
- Amount: $164,800.00 (covers annual renewal + 2 Dedicated GPU nodes expansion)
- Terms: net30 from invoice date (due 2026-04-01)
- PO: 54321 (included on invoice header)
- Deal ref: RDF-2026-ACME-02

Please confirm receipt when convenient. Acme noted they would provide the formal W-9; once we have that we’ll upload it to the customer record. If you need the invoice delivered to a different billing address or a one-time ACH instruction sheet, let me know and I’ll update.

Payment instructions and wire details are included in the invoice PDF.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
